profile.description: Unqualified VNNI/BF16-prefill starting profile for a GCP c4-standard-24: 12 physical Intel cores, 24 logical CPUs, AMX present in the host but deliberately excluded from this binary.

hardware.notes: GCP c4-standard-24, one socket and one NUMA node. The host exposes AMX tile/INT8/BF16 and SMT siblings 0-11 / 12-23, but this profile is VNNI-only in the operational sense: rebuild with SIMD=avx512bf16, which includes AVX-512 VNNI and BF16 but no AMX compiler flags. Yesterday's SIMD=avx512vnni campaign did not compile the BF16 matmat unit and is historical evidence only. Qualify SMT-on and SMT-off separately; the conservative starting topology is 2 workers x 6 physical cores with SMT off. Visible shared L3 is 260 MiB, not 260 MiB per core. The previous host sweep measured approximately 101.5 GB/s Triad on the 12-CPU physical mask and 106.0 GB/s on all 24 logical CPUs; these are roof references, not per-worker bandwidth obtained by division.

requirements.isa: AVX-512 VNNI and AVX-512 BF16; no AMX code in this profile
requirements.ingot: clean rebuild on the GCP x86 toolchain; do not copy a macOS or Arm static library

server.worker_affinity: SMT-off starting point: worker 0 -> CPUs 0-5; worker 1 -> CPUs 6-11. Re-measure the same topology with SMT-on siblings explicitly before using 24 logical CPUs.

precision.talker_weights: int8 per output row; BF16 copy retained for quality-preserving prefill
precision.activations: fp32 at the API boundary; AVX-512 VNNI activation packing is internal to INT8 paths
precision.gemm_backend: AVX-512 BF16 VDPBF16PS for native BF16 prefill matmat, AVX-512 VNNI VPDPBUSD for INT8/Q4 batched paths, and OpenBLAS SGEMM only for the explicit fallback/control path; AMX is intentionally not compiled

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: Must be absent: the engine sizes OpenBLAS from the worker phase budget. An inherited value silently replaces the measured thread split.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.revert: Set explicitly only for a measured control run.

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: Starting value copied from the measured x86/Arm profiles: parks idle OpenBLAS workers instead of letting them contend with the engine pool. Re-measure on this C4 after the corrected BF16 build.

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: Keeps the request-independent prompt head enabled for repeated serving requests; already used by the previous C4 campaign.

QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.why: Required for this candidate after rebuilding SIMD=avx512bf16: it requests the native BF16 prefill and the new dispatch gate will fail before measurement if the BF16 unit is not compiled/supported. The old SIMD=avx512vnni binary could not satisfy this request.
QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.revert: QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT=0 for the explicit BLAS control path.

QWEN_PREFILL_QUANT.why: Quality-preserving reference: quantized prefill remains a separate candidate and is not enabled by this profile.
QWEN_PREFILL_QUANT.revert: QWEN_PREFILL_QUANT=1 only for a separately qualified base-model control.

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: Keeps the two-position Code Predictor prefill path explicit for an AVX-512 VNNI build; it was active in the previous C4 runs.

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: Starting x86 value and the value used in the previous C4 measurements. It is not copied from Axion: Linux/aarch64 defaults to 65536, while x86 defaults to 4096. The corrected BF16 build still needs a short C4 A/B for 0/4096/65536.
QWEN_POOL_SPIN.revert: Unset for the compiled x86 default; test 0 or 65536 only as separate controls.

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: Starting value from the prior C4 VNNI campaign. The server would otherwise enable decoder batching; whether the wider SMT-on C4 can amortize it is a separate measurement.

QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK.why: The previous C4 VNNI runs used an eight-frame steady-state chunk; keep it fixed while changing only the build/dispatch capability.
QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK.revert: Change only in a paired streaming A/B.

QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK_BUSY.why: Busy-stream override was disabled in the previous C4 campaign; keep the baseline isolated.
QWEN_STREAM_DECODE_CHUNK_BUSY.revert: Set a nonzero value only in a paired control.

QWEN_VNNI_GEMV_MR.why: The previous C4 VNNI run used the two-row GEMV microkernel. Retain it while correcting only the BF16 compiler capability.

QWEN_NO_AMX.why: Must remain absent: AMX is excluded by the SIMD=avx512bf16 build, not by a runtime kill switch. This makes a mistaken AMX build visible in the dispatch map instead of hiding it behind an env flag.
QWEN_NO_AMX.revert: QWEN_NO_AMX=1 is only a control on an AMX binary.

QWEN_NO_AMX_BF16.why: Absent because the VNNI/BF16 profile has no AMX BF16 code; it is relevant only to an AMX build.
QWEN_NO_AMX_BF16.revert: Set only for an AMX per-consumer control.

QWEN_NO_AMX_INT8.why: Absent because the VNNI/BF16 profile has no AMX INT8 code; it is relevant only to an AMX build.
QWEN_NO_AMX_INT8.revert: Set only for an AMX per-consumer control.

QWEN_NO_VNNI.why: Must remain absent so the native AVX-512 VNNI INT8/Q4 paths are available.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: Must remain absent so the shape-aware VNNI tiled matmat remains available.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_ROWSUM.why: Must remain absent so cached INT8 row sums are used by VNNI GEMV.

QWEN_NO_VNNI_ACT_QUANT.why: Must remain absent so AVX-512 activation quantization remains enabled in the VNNI path.

QWEN_NO_BF16_MATMUL.why: Must remain absent: with QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT=1 this is the direct kill switch for the AVX-512 BF16 prefill unit, and the dispatch gate now rejects that contradiction.
QWEN_NO_BF16_MATMUL.revert: Set to 1 only for the explicit BLAS/fallback control.

QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK.why: Candidate only; previous C4 VNNI measurements did not establish a stable end-to-end win.
QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK.revert: QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK=cp or =1 in a separate candidate run.

QWEN_VNNI_NCHUNK.why: Not pinned until a corrected-build C4 measurement shows a stable p95/RTF win.
QWEN_VNNI_NCHUNK.revert: Set a row count only for a paired A/B.

QWEN_AVX512_NCHUNK.why: Experimental output-row chunking for the AVX-512 BF16 family; no C4 measurement exists under the corrected build yet.
QWEN_AVX512_NCHUNK.revert: Set only for a paired A/B.

qualification.workload: NONE YET for this corrected SIMD=avx512bf16 profile. The 2026-09-05 C4 VNNI results used SIMD=avx512vnni and are retained as historical comparison, not qualification.
qualification.speaker: ryan
qualification.notes: First action on the next boot: clean-rebuild Ingot and the engine with make -B blas SIMD=avx512bf16 -j12, verify --caps reports AVX-512 BF16 VDPBF16PS and AMX not compiled, then run --dispatch-map under this profile. The gate must show talker.prefill.matmat_bf16 compiled=yes supported=yes resolved=ON and f32_blas_fallback=OFF before any suite or soak. SMT-off 2x6 is the conservative starting topology; SMT-on 4x6 and 3x8 remain separate candidates from the old build and must be rechecked after the BF16 correction.
